correctness.rationale: For every G and m≥2, two white false twins in a fibre are a permanent ordinary forcing obstruction. With at most one white per fibre, each fibre has a blue vertex, whose white-neighbor count is exactly the skew white-neighbor count in G. This is an exact bidirectional stepwise simulation for disconnected bases as well as connected ones. The labelled omitted-vertex count yields both substitution identities, and deletion tests yield the exact inclusion-minimal equivalence. Cycle degree two turns skew propagation into distance-two graph infection, with one odd component or two even components. The symbolic proof covers all n and m. An independent exhaustive C++ verifier checked all 1110 labelled base/multiplicity cases through base order five, including each actual initial subset, and separate cycle parameters; observed output ALL_BASE_GRAPHS_AND_ALL_SUBSETS_OK, CYCLE ... OK and TRANSFER_MINIMAL_AND_CYCLE_CERTIFICATES_OK. Limits: exhaustive finite checks are supplementary and do not imply infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2022 publication asks explicitly for sparse connected vertex-transitive graph families with exponential minimal ordinary zero-forcing sets, while its example uses unbounded degree. Prior general lexicographic-product studies provide scalar bounds, prior tensor-product work uses skew forcing for a different adjacency and an upper bound, and published clique-expanded cycles are true-twin rather than false-twin. No stronger or equivalent full/minimal polynomial transform or bounded-degree cycle witness was found in actual indexed searches, relevant full-text sections, or accessible own claims. Publication priority provisional; indexed absence cannot establish absolute novelty.

value.rationale: An exact all-graphs transfer links ordinary and skew zero-forcing dynamics and determines both total and inclusion-minimal generating polynomials by one substitution. A natural application answers an explicit 2022 open existence question using 4-regular, triangle-free, connected vertex-transitive graphs, whereas the published exponential vertex-transitive construction had unbounded degree. The parity-dependent exact labelled counts make the consequence informative beyond mere existence and are reproducible.
